main_text.l: 1 Quoniam fidem coniugalem frangere
& mœchari turpe est, & malum: sicut contrà
here matrimonium ac fidem seruare hone-
stum & bonum (siquidem sit in Domino)
quemadmodum Apostolus dicit, Heb.13.
Honorabile est inter omnes coniugium, & cu-
bile impollutum: scortatores autem & adul-
teros iudicabit Deus: & quoniam nunc sunt
extrema tempora, quæ sunt, ut Christus pr-
ædixit, sicut tempora Nohæ & Lothi: idcirco
diligenter monendi sumus, ut fugiamus o-
mnem immunditiam, scortationem, & adul-
terium: ne cum mundo pereamus.
Ut autem cauere queamus à mala fœmini-
na, obseruemus primo, quod Salomon hic
dicit: Retine fili mi (alloquitur autem Deus
in Salomone omnem hominem) patris tui
præceptum (honorandi enim sunt paren-
tes) neue omitte aut deferas legem matris
tuæ

page.notes: Fragment "plum" at the start is the end of a word broken across the page break (septuplum), kept as printed. "etiā" is uncertain: the m-abbreviation over a vowel may be read as etiam. "here" after "contrà" is doubtful. "Heb.13." reading of the chapter number is uncertain (printed as 1 with a 3-like sign). "deferas" is uncertain. Long s and the u/v, i/j spellings were normalised. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
